name: openbb_index_available
description:
List of market indices a provider covers (symbol, name, currency and more) through the OpenBB Platform (obb.index.available).
Returns: {tool, data_points (total rows), data: first 100 rows as OpenBB returns them} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): provider (fmp or yfinance; schema default fmp; when omitted the tool sends yfinance, which needs no key).
Index history: openbb_index_price_historical, yf_index_history. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"provider": "yfinance"}
